service.description: The send outcomes of the instance's stored outgoing mail (EmailMessage: Ready, Sent, Bounced or Cancelled; never a draft, a scheduled message or received mail), newest first, a page at a time (outcomeList, outcomeCount). Each: the message's id, status, state (retryable: not sent; permanent: refused; bounced; uncertain: it may have been sent; sending; sent; cancelled) with its text, the outcome the mail service kept, the time, the number of recipients, the error with every address struck out, its mail server, template and binding (account: a mail account's message; instance: the instance's own), its owner (ownerKind mailAccount, registered with the owner's key, title, reference and state, or mailService), what may be done here (retryEligible, reconcileEligible, abandonEligible, each only with ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE), the next step in words and the revision an action names. Never a subject, body, header, address or attachment: no parameter returns one. Narrowed by state (attention, the default: Ready and Bounced; retryable, permanent, uncertain, bounced, sent, all), mail server, template, binding, one message and dates (by default the last defaultDays days). An owner that could not be asked is named in unansweredOwnerList, and nothing of the instance's own is then offered a retry. Needs ADMIN_OPERATION_VIEW; with ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW alone, only the instance's own mail is read (instanceOnly), never a mail account's message.

Send again a message that is known not sent (retryable, permanent or bounced), through its owner, at the revision read. A message of the mail service's own (no mail account, no registered owner) is claimed first and then sent by org.moqui.mail.EmailServices.send#EmailMessage: the same stored message, never a new one. A registered owner's message is retried by that owner's own service when it offers one (OWNER_RETRIES when it does not). Refused, with the reason: a message that may have been sent (RECONCILE_REQUIRED: it is reconciled, never sent again from here), one in a mail account's Outbox (OWNER_ONLY: its sender's), one already sent or cancelled (NOT_FAILED), one being sent (IN_PROGRESS), a stale revision (STALE_REVISION), an owner that could not be asked (OWNER_UNAVAILABLE) and a send that fails again (SEND_FAILED, with the new state). With an operationKey a repeat answers the first result (repeated) and sends nothing. Needs ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE.

What a person found out about a message whose send is uncertain, with the reason (required, kept in the audit log), at the revision read: sent (the mail server's own log shows it went: the message is marked Sent), notSent (it is then known not sent and may be retried) or abandon (a failed or uncertain message of the mail service's own is closed, Cancelled, and not offered again). Nothing is sent. A registered owner's message is reconciled by that owner's own service, which checks the owner's permission (OWNER_RECONCILES when it offers none); a mail account's message is its sender's (OWNER_ONLY). Refused too for a message that is not uncertain (NOT_UNCERTAIN, for sent and notSent), one sent or cancelled (NOT_FAILED), a stale revision and an owner that could not be asked. With an operationKey a repeat answers the first result. Needs ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE.

Internal to retry#MailOutcome (in no group's grant; it checks ADMIN_OPERATION_MANAGE itself): in a transaction of its own, the message locked and, while it is still at the revision read and still known not sent, marked uncertain with the claim's time, so a second request and a server that stops part way both find it held. With release the claim's time is cleared.

What a registered owner of mail send outcomes answers (moqui.server.MailOutcomeOwner ownerService): which of the given EmailMessages are its own (ownerList: emailMessageId, ownerRef the owner's own record, ownerStateText its state there in words, retryEligible and reconcileEligible when its recover service would take that action now, selfRetrying when it tries the message again on its own). A message it does not answer is not its own. It reads its own records only and returns no address, subject or body.

A registered owner's own action on one of its messages (MailOutcomeOwner recoverService): retry (send it again its own way), or the reconciliation of an uncertain send, sent or notSent. The owner checks its own permission and its record's state, and answers applied, or reasonCode and reason; the registration adds no right.
